consequence.statement: New CLI commands for reconciling, suspending and resuming image policies are available. Existing setups do not need any change.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds the CLI commands `flux reconcile image policy`, `flux suspend image policy` and `flux resume image policy`.
